answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring every identity to post a refundable stake before trading, then assigning jobs through random committees of established peers. Committees compare signed interaction histories and slash the stake when linked identities coordinate to inflate reputation or reroute payments. A nebula of accounts therefore cannot cheaply manufacture trust: each fake identity ties up capital, risks forfeiture, and must survive repeated audits by peers such as raven and willow.
